name: TownCenter
description: Starting building. Trains Workers, is the drop-off point for gathered resources and gives +25 population capacity. If your Town Center is destroyed you lose the match.

name: House
description: Cheap building that raises the population cap by +5. Build Houses before the population limit blocks unit training.

name: Barracks
description: Military building required to train Spearmen and Archers (Marines and Snipers in Sci-Fi). Training queue holds up to 5 units.

name: Stable
description: Required to train Cavalry (Tanks in Sci-Fi). Training queue holds up to 5 units.

name: Blacksmith
description: Research building. All Weapon, Armor and Wall upgrades are researched here, one research at a time. If it is destroyed during research, the research is cancelled and refunded.

name: Mine
description: Gold-only building (75 gold, 2x2) that produces +10 gold every 10 seconds while one Worker is assigned inside it (max 1 worker). It does not need a gold node: it can be placed on any explored, open 2x2 ground. The worker inside is hidden and cannot be attacked. Build it when gold income is low.

name: DefenseTower
description: Defensive tower (100 gold, 2x2). It must be manned by one soldier to fire: an Archer in Medieval, a Marine or Sniper in Sci-Fi. Archer Tower: 12 damage, range 6.5, every 1.6 s. Rocket Turret: 30 damage, range 7, every 3 s. Only Archers can damage an enemy Archer Tower and only Tanks can damage an enemy Rocket Turret. Place it on the side attacks come from or next to mines and farms.

name: Wall
description: 1x1 wall segment, 10 wood each (5 s to build), drawn by dragging. Walls block movement, so leave a gap/gate for your own units and keep resource paths open. Health depends on the wall tier: Medieval Wood/Stone/Brick = 300/600/1000 HP, Sci-Fi Cement/Iron/Obsidian = 450/900/1500 HP. Upgrading also upgrades existing walls. Walls never catch fire.

name: HealthCenter
description: Healing building (100 wood + 50 gold, 3x3; Medieval: Health Center, Sci-Fi: Med Bay). Own units whose HP drops below 30% go there automatically when they are idle (not gathering, building, fighting a fire, farming, mining, fighting or guarding a tower). Inside they are hidden from the map for 5 seconds and come out with full HP. Up to 4 units at a time (inside or walking there). You can also right-click your Health Center with wounded units selected to send them in at any HP. If the building is destroyed the units inside come out with their current HP.

name: Farm
description: Farm plot (Sci-Fi: Hydro Farm), 10 wood per 1x1 cell on explored open ground. Planting costs 10 food, the wheat grows for about 45 seconds and the harvest returns 30 food (3x the seed, net 2x profit). Plots never run out: after a harvest the plot is empty and can be planted again. Idle workers nearby farm automatically. Build farms when food is low.
